snippet.title: Norse: Oath of Blood – Story Developer Diary + Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
This first developer diary from Norse: Oath of Blood dives deep into the development team's focus on story in the upcoming turn-based tactical strategy game set in Viking-Age Norway. 
Tripwire Presents, the publishing division of Tripwire Interactive, and developer Arctic Hazard will release the game for Windows PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S on Feb. 3, 2026.

#IGN #Gaming
